map.土壤湿度多少算旱？: What soil moisture counts as drought?
map.因作物与质地异，常见田间持水量 60% 以下需关注、40% 以下受旱，沙土阈值更: It varies with crop and soil texture; generally below 60% of field capacity warrants attention and below 40% means drought stress, with lower thresholds for sandy soils.
map.喷药看风还是看雨？: Watch the wind or the rain when spraying?
map.都看：风速>4 m/s 飘移、雨前 6h 内打药被冲，宜选静风无雨时段。: Watch both: wind above 4 m/s causes drift, and spraying within 6h before rain gets washed off, so pick a calm, rain-free window.
